qa_pairs.question: What is the amperage rating of fuse 28 in the cigar lighter circuit?
Which fuse protects the auto-charging flashlight circuit and what is its rating?
qa_pairs.answer: Fuse 21 protects the auto-charging flashlight circuit and is rated at 7.5 AMP.

qa_pairs.question: What voltage is present at wire connection C103 in the glove box light circuit?
qa_pairs.answer: 1.5 V/GY is present at connection C103 in the glove box light circuit.

qa_pairs.question: Which circuits are hot at all times according to the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The cigar lighter circuit (fuse 28) and the auto-charging flashlight circuit (fuse 21) are hot at all times.

qa_pairs.question: What is the amperage rating of fuse 4 that supplies the glove box light?
Which circuits are only hot in ACC, RUN or START positions?
qa_pairs.answer: The glove box light circuit (fuse 4) and the map reading light circuit (fuse 8) are hot in ACC, RUN or START positions.

qa_pairs.question: What component controls the active check function shown in the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The Active Check Control component controls the active check function, receiving 5 V/GY input.

qa_pairs.question: What important note is provided at the bottom of the diagram regarding vehicle variations?
qa_pairs.answer: Some vehicles may contain an additional splice (see ground distribution).
